title: Functional CLT for general sample covariance matrices
summary: This paper studies the central limit theorems (CLTs) for linear spectral statistics (LSSs) of general sample covariance matrices, when the test functions belong to $C^3$, the class of functions with continuous third order derivatives. We consider matrices of the form $B_n=(1/n)T_p^{1/2}X_nX_n^{*}T_p^{1/2},$ where $X_n= (x_{i j} ) $ is a $p \times n$ matrix whose entries are independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) real or complex random variables, and $T_p$ is a $p\times p$ nonrandom Hermitian nonnegative definite matrix with its spectral norm uniformly bounded in $p$.
